name: Redis latency
description: Running a pair of redis server and benchmarking client (memtier_benchmark) on each vCPU to evaluate the performance of SET operations, using different number of concurrent pipelined requests. The average latency reported by memtier_benchmark.
note: Latency is recorded during the redis:rps run, not as a standalone benchmark. As it reflects a characteristic of that throughput measurement, it is not recommended for comparing instances on its own; use it instead as a filter when interpreting the related throughput scores.

config_fields.pipeline: The number of concurrent pipelined requests.
config_fields.operation: Type of operation, e.g. SET or GET a key.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
